zh: 关联任务：第一章《被流放的英雄》。
当前可读内容：冲锋、落冰与正面冰攻击的基础应对，以及战前补给提醒。
en: Related mission: Chapter 1, The Banished Hero.
Current notes cover the charge, falling ice, a frontal ice attack and preparation before the fight.

zh: 卡赞在开场任务取得刀斧，因此适合从第一章开始记录它的操作与技能。
本站尚未列出各单件刀斧的属性、获取地点或强度排名。
en: Khazan receives paired blades in the opening mission, making Chapter 1 the starting point for this class.
Individual stats, acquisition routes and rankings have not yet been checked.

zh: 巨剑是官方列出的三类武器之一。
后续单件资料将区分基础武器、版本赠品与装备套装，不混作普通掉落。
en: Greatsword is one of the three weapon classes listed by the publisher.
Future entries will distinguish standard weapons, edition bonuses and gear sets.

zh: 长枪是官方列出的三类武器之一。
后续单件资料将记录技能、获取条件和版本信息。
en: Spear is one of the three weapon classes listed by the publisher.
Future entries will record skills, acquisition conditions and version information.

zh: 官方说明称，穿戴完整套装可获得特殊属性或技能，也可以混搭不同套装。
具体套装效果需要按名称、件数和游戏版本分别记录。
en: The official store page describes full-set bonuses and mixed loadouts.
Specific effects will be recorded by set name, piece count and game version.

zh: 英雄武器与防具套装属于豪华版专属内容；官方说明不能通过之后的其他方式取得。
官方列出的套装加成按穿戴 2 至 6 件逐级触发，分别增加 Vitality、Endurance、Proficiency、Strength 和 Willpower 各 5 点。
en: The Hero's weapon and armor set is a Deluxe Edition exclusive, not a standard mission drop.
The official 2–6 piece bonuses add 5 each to Vitality, Endurance, Proficiency, Strength and Willpower in sequence.

zh: 技能点可用于解锁技能；不同武器的技能还需要按类别分别整理。
正式推荐某项技能前，应核对解锁前置、实际效果与当前游戏版本。
en: Skill Points unlock abilities; weapon-specific skills will be organized by class.
Recommendations will require checks of prerequisites, effects and the current game version.

zh: 官方说明支持随时随地重置和重新分配技能。
本站尚未核对具体菜单步骤；不会把技能重置与角色属性重置混为一谈。
en: The official store description says skill points can be reset and reassigned at any time and from anywhere.
The exact menu steps remain unchecked; skill respec and attribute reset are tracked separately.

zh: 死亡后可返回倒下地点取回失去的 Lacrima，以继续升级。
连续死亡等情况下的损失规则和具体界面提示仍待实机核验。
en: After death, returning to the defeat location can recover lost Lacrima for progression.
Loss rules and exact interface messages in repeat-death cases still need hands-on review.

zh: 官方故事页列出的量表来源包括击败敌人、Brutal Attack 与 Spirit 技能。
量表满后可在限定时间内变身；变身期间受到的伤害会扣除幻影形态量表而非生命值。
en: The official story page names enemy defeats, Brutal Attacks and Spirit skills as gauge sources.
At a full gauge, Khazan can transform for a limited time; damage taken then drains the Phantom Form gauge rather than health.

zh: 官方列有新游戏＋和终极挑战两个后续游玩方向。
终极挑战包含不同规则的首领挑战；其属性与装备重置规则应与新游戏＋分开说明。
en: The official store page lists New Game+ and Ultimate Challenge as postgame options.
Ultimate Challenge boss modes have separate rules; their stat and equipment resets should not be confused with New Game+.

zh: 卡赞曾是佩洛斯帝国的大将军，并参与击败狂龙。
被诬陷为叛徒后遭受酷刑并流放雪山；故事从他的死里逃生与复仇开始。
en: Khazan was a general of the Pell Los Empire and a hero of the battle against the Berserk Dragon.
After being framed, tortured and banished, his survival begins the revenge story.

zh: 刀锋幻影来自冥界，寻找能承载自身力量的容器。
它与卡赞的结盟同时推动剧情与幻影形态机制。
en: Blade Phantom comes from the Netherworld and seeks a vessel able to contain its power.
Its alliance with Khazan underpins both the story and Phantom Form.

zh: 奥兹玛曾与卡赞共同对抗狂龙。
官方人物简介说明，他随后也因叛国指控而失势；更深的剧情关系会另行标注剧透。
en: Ozma fought the Berserk Dragon alongside Khazan.
The official profile says he also fell from grace after treason accusations; later story details will carry spoiler labels.

zh: Quimuk 是救下卡赞的班图萨满；中文译名仍待游戏内核对。
官方简介说，她建议通过班图仪式驱逐卡赞体内的幽魂。
en: Quimuk is the Bantu shaman who rescued Khazan from the snowy mountains.
Her official profile says she proposed a Bantu ritual to drive out the phantom within him.

zh: 《被流放的英雄》前段敌人之后可检查“押送令”这一剧情物品。
目前只确认这一条线索；本页尚不能代替本章全收集路线。
en: The transport order is a story item noted after an early encounter in The Banished Hero.
Only this lead has been checked; this page is not a complete collectible route.

zh: 长枪投掷可能接瞬移砸击；锤击产生前方尖刺。
第二阶段增加爪击与瞬移，爆发攻击使用反击应对。
en: A spear throw can lead into a teleporting slam; hammer attacks create frontal spikes.
Phase two adds claws and teleports; respond to Burst Attacks with Counterattack.

zh: 长枪延迟出手，不要过早防御；抓取应拉开距离。
第二阶段区分快匕首与慢拳击，注意拍地后的投石。
en: Avoid guarding too early against delayed spear attacks; move away from grabs.
Distinguish fast daggers from slower punches, and watch for rock throws after palm slams.

zh: 试炼雪山：狼群区域木结构后、冻湖左洞、冰峡谷高处悬崖。
被遗忘的神庙：入口前木障碍后、入口楼梯右支路、第二石像机关后。
en: Stormpass: behind the wolf-area structure, Frozen Lake’s left cave, and the high Ice Canyon cliff.
Temple: pre-entrance barriers, right of the entrance stairs, and behind the second statue puzzle.

zh: 冰峡谷：存档点附近小壶。
神庙深处：第二处旋转陷阱之后，下行楼梯左侧小壶。
en: Ice Canyon: the small jar near the Nexus.
Temple depths: left of the descending stairs after the second rotating trap.

zh: 乘电梯进入神庙地下后，在存档点附近完成对话。
收集鬼石后查看服务菜单，按自己的强化需求选择。
en: Speak to her near the Nexus after descending by elevator.
After collecting Soulstones, check her service menu for your preferred upgrades.

zh: 注意冲击波与后半场残留火焰，用场地梯子避开下层起火。
en: Watch shockwaves and persistent fire; use the ladder when the lower floor ignites.

zh: 准备抗毒与解毒，针对前肢和腹部；爬墙时用投枪打断。
en: Prepare poison resistance and cleansing; target legs and abdomen, and interrupt wall retreats with Javelin.

zh: 下落后进入开门建筑，登梯并从对面落下，到出口检查。
en: Enter the open building after dropping, climb its ladder and drop opposite to check the exit.

zh: 火抗与净化；留意长距离末尾砸击和旋转喷火。
en: Use fire resistance and cleansing; watch the long final slam and spinning flames.

zh: 准备混沌净化，分开学习慢巨剑与快刀阶段；抓取不可用普通防御应对。
en: Prepare Chaos cleansing; learn slow greatswords and fast blades separately, and evade grabs.

zh: 完成后查看属性变更与装备强化服务。
强化会消耗选定的供体装备，操作前核对菜单。
en: Check attribute alteration and gear augmentation after completion.
Augmentation consumes the selected donor gear; review the menu before proceeding.

zh: 绕背短打，避免疲竭；准备雷电净化。
en: Attack briefly from behind, avoid exhaustion and prepare Lightning cleansing.

zh: 瘟疫攻击优先闪避，高跳落地后留意续招。
en: Evade Plague attacks and read follow-ups after the high leap.

zh: 电梯下行后沿斜坡进入左房，检查左侧牢门。
en: Below the elevator, follow the slope into the left room and inspect its left cell.

zh: 目的地为 Forgotten Underground Canal，完成后返回裂隙。
en: Visit Forgotten Underground Canal and return to The Crevice after completion.

zh: 目的地为 Mine No. 2 Workyard；完成后查看 Last Command。
en: Visit Mine No. 2 Workyard; check Last Command after completion.

zh: 红水母带毒，蓝水母恢复精力；伞形爆发可反击。
en: Red jellyfish poison, blue restore stamina; counter umbrella Burst Attacks.

zh: 打断施法和骷髅蓄能，准备多种元素净化。
en: Interrupt casting and skull energy; prepare elemental cleansing.

zh: 城塞大门右侧窄巷地面，拾取后保留。
en: Collect from the alley right of the citadel gate and keep it.

zh: 目的地 Ivy Annex；击败 Gwydo 后检查棺木并完成 Tristan 对话。
en: Visit Ivy Annex; after Gwydo, inspect the coffin and finish Tristan’s dialogue.

zh: 前往 Wastus Canyon，击败任务首领并完成对话后返回裂隙。
en: Visit Wastus Canyon, defeat its mission boss and finish the dialogue before returning.

zh: 攻击棺木打断仪式，巨剑与棺击分开应对。
en: Interrupt coffin rituals; distinguish greatsword and coffin attacks.

zh: 准备混沌净化，观察合唱队声波方向。
en: Prepare Chaos cleansing and read choir wave directions.

zh: 分别核对 Aldevir、Vaisar 和 Rovelion，集齐后保留。
完成帝国的末日后与 Daphrona 查看誓约。
en: Check Aldevir, Vaisar and Rovelion; keep all three.
After Fall of the Empire, check The Vow with Daphrona.

zh: 完成战斗与兄弟剧情，再由临时存档点离开。
en: Finish the battles and brothers’ scene, then leave via the temporary Nexus.

zh: 击败 Remnant of Elamein 后完成 Daphrona 对话。
en: Defeat Remnant of Elamein and finish Daphrona’s dialogue.

zh: 优先破角与额头弱点，虚弱飞行时用投枪。
en: Break the horn and target the forehead; use Javelin in weakened flight.

zh: 利用墙壁挡投枪，打断混沌蓄能，保留两阶段补给。
en: Use walls against spears, interrupt Chaos buildup and reserve healing for both phases.

zh: 处理地面长枪，保留后期恢复；结局选择见终章。
en: Clear embedded spears and reserve recovery; see the finale for ending choices.

zh: 目的地 Temple of Shadows，完成任务并核对金色档案。
en: Visit Temple of Shadows and check its gold records.

zh: 目的地 Vitalon Underground Passage，完成三场连续战斗。
en: Visit Vitalon Underground Passage and finish three consecutive battles.

zh: 不以鬼石数量或首领阶段数代替档案与任务条件核对。
en: Do not substitute Soulstone totals or boss phase count for record and mission checks.
